business.about: Incorporated in 1992, Subex Ltd is a global provider of Operations and Business Support Systems to communication service providers worldwide, in the Telecom industry [1]
business.in_their_words: What we are trying to do is to create the foundation from which we can build the next phase of Subex. We are moving towards a world in which software does not merely process information or recommend actions. Second, we see an opportunity to position Subex as a platform neutral integrity and decision there. Increasingly what we are seeing is machines, bots, and autonomous agents will initiate and execute activities on behalf of people and enterprises. And in that sense, we are witnessing the very reinvention of the old principle of maker-checker mechanism. So, importantly, this is an opportunity that does not require us to bet on which AI platform ultimately wins, and that's not the battle that we are in. results.read: Revenue +25% YoY; EBITDA margin expanded 1223 bps YoY to 21% — the highest in 9 quarters; PAT +367% — profits outran sales.

calls: Growth is accelerating: revenue CAGR 0.0% over 3y vs -5.6% over 5y
Weak cash conversion: 5-yr operating cash flow is -0.33× reported profit
